title: First return during machine composition
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be deterministic machines with $k$ work tapes and a common input alphabet, with states in sets $S_1$ and $S_2$. Form a machine with state set $S_1\sqcup S_2$ that follows $M_1$ on left states, switches from the exit state of $M_1$ to the specified entry state of $M_2$ in one step without changing the tapes, and follows $M_2$ on right states. If $M_1$ reaches configuration $c_1$ from $c_0$ after $T_1$ steps, first visits the exit state at that time, and $M_2$, started from the tapes and head positions of $c_1$ with its state replaced by the entry state, reaches $c_3$ after $T_2$ steps with state $q_2$, and does not visit $q_2$ earlier, then the composed machine does not have state $q_2$ in its right component at any time $t<T_1+1+T_2$ when started from $c_0$ with its state placed in the left component.
hypotheses_covered: $M_1,M_2$ are machines with $k$ work tapes and common symbol alphabet
No state along the first $T_1$ steps before time $T_1$ is $exit$
$M_2$ reaches $c_3$ in $T_2$ steps from $c_1$ with its state replaced by $entry$
No state along the first $T_2$ steps before time $T_2$ is $q_2$
